self_help.title: You may be able to fix this yourself in 5 minutes
self_help.intro: Low boiler pressure (below 1 bar) is one of the most common boiler issues - and it's often something you can fix yourself without a callout.
steps: Turn off the boiler and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Locate the filling loop - it's usually a silver flexible hose with one or two valves under or beside the boiler.
Slowly open the valves (turn them so the slot aligns with the pipe). You'll hear water filling.
Watch the pressure gauge. When it reaches 1.0 to 1.5 bar, close the valves.
Turn your boiler back on. If the E118 error clears, you're done.
self_help.warning: If pressure keeps dropping within 24 hours, there may be a leak in the system - that needs a professional.
self_help.followup: Give it a try and let me know how it goes. If it doesn't fix it, or you'd rather have a Gas Safe engineer do it, I can get you a quote right now.
